help.send.title: Send files
help.send.intro: Upload files and get a link anyone can open. Nothing is public until the link exists.
help.send.item1Text: Drop files or whole folders on the box, or click it to choose. Several files upload at once and the speed is shown. If the connection drops, the upload continues by itself, and you can pause and continue later.
help.send.item2Text: Shown to the people who open the link. A custom link makes the address readable, like /s/holiday-photos.
help.send.item3Text: Choose how many days the link works, or that it never expires. Expired links are removed automatically; their files stay in your library unless you turn off keeping them.
help.send.item4Text: With a password, visitors must enter it before they see the files. A download limit closes the link after that many downloads.
help.send.item5Text: Emails you when someone downloads. Needs an email address on your account.
help.send.item6Text: When the upload is done you get the link to copy, a QR code and a button to send it by email.
help.library.title: File library
help.library.intro: Your private files and folders. Nothing here is public until you share it.
help.library.item1Text: Upload files or a whole folder into the folder you are in. Unfinished uploads can be continued.
help.library.item2Text: Create folders, move files between them and star the ones you use often. All files, Starred and Unfiled show files across folders.
help.library.item3Text: Click a file name to view it: pictures, PDFs, video, audio and text. Text files can be edited in the browser, and earlier versions are kept.
help.library.item4Text: Select files, or a whole folder, and share them as one link. You can stop sharing at any time.
help.library.item5Text: Ask someone to send you files. They get a link where they can upload, and the files land in your library.
help.library.item6Text: The box at the bottom of the menu shows how much of your space is used, including uploads in progress.
help.shares.title: My shares
help.shares.item1Text: Find a share by its name or description.
help.shares.item2Text: Each share shows when it expires, how often and when it was last downloaded, and whether it has a password.
help.shares.item3Text: Copy the link again, show its QR code or send it by email.
help.shares.item4Text: Change the name, description, expiry and the other settings of a share.
help.shares.item5Text: Removes the link and its files at once. The link stops working for everyone.
help.shares.item6Text: A share whose upload did not finish. Continue it to finish, or delete it.
help.admin.title: Administration
help.admin.intro: Settings for the whole server. Only administrators see this page.
help.admin.item1Text: Type in the search box to show only matching settings, or jump to a section with the list beside them.
help.admin.item2Text: Accounts, links, files, downloads, failed sign-ins and storage at a glance, with warnings for things that need attention.
help.admin.item3Text: Create accounts, set each person's storage quota, reset passwords and two-step login, and disable or delete accounts. Invitations send a sign-up link by email.
help.admin.item4Text: Limits set the storage budget, the default quota, the largest file and link, and how long links last. Permissions decide what regular accounts may do; exceptions are set per person.
help.admin.item5Text: The mail server used for invitations, password resets, download notices and alerts. Send a test email to check it.
help.admin.item6Text: Where file contents are kept: this server or an added folder such as a mounted network share. Files can be moved between them, and you are warned when one is offline.
help.admin.item7Text: Your own name, color and logo; new versions of MagiSend; and a log of sign-ins and changes.
help.public.title: Shared files
help.public.intro: Someone has shared these files with you.
help.public.item1Text: Click a file name to view it in the browser, when the file type allows it.
help.public.item2Text: Download the files one by one, or all of them at once.
help.public.item3Text: If the share is protected, enter the password you were given.
help.public.item4Text: The link stops working after its expiry date or download limit, so download what you need in time.
help.request.title: Upload files
help.request.intro: Someone has asked you to send them files.
help.request.item1Text: Drop files on the box or click it to choose. Large files upload in parts and continue if the connection drops.
help.request.item2Text: Only the person who asked receives the files. Nothing you upload here becomes public.
help.signin.title: Signing in
help.signin.intro: Sign in with the account you were given.
help.signin.item1Text: Use the reset link if it is shown, and you get an email. Otherwise ask an administrator.
help.signin.item2Text: If it is on for your account, enter the code from your authenticator app after your password.
help.signin.item3Text: Change the language with the gear at the top, and switch between light and dark with the sun or moon.

errors.zip_empty: There is nothing in this archive to unpack.
errors.archive_changed: The archive changed while it was being read. Try again.
errors.file_infected: A virus was found in this file, so it cannot be opened, downloaded or unpacked.

antivirus.title: Virus scanning
antivirus.intro: New files can be checked with ClamAV, which runs next to MagiSend. A file is held back until its scan is done, usually a few seconds; one in which a virus is found cannot be opened, downloaded or unpacked by anyone. Uploads are not slowed down.
antivirus.modeHint: Files received from others are those from upload requests and from people adding files to a shared link. Files stored before scanning was switched on are not scanned.
antivirus.addressHint: Only needed when ClamAV runs on another machine or container: host:port, or unix:/path/to/clamd.socket. Leave it empty to use ClamAV on this server.
antivirus.maxSizeHint: Larger files are not scanned and not held back. ClamAV's own limits (StreamMaxLength and MaxFileSize) must be at least this large; the Install ClamAV button sets them to 100 MB.
antivirus.failing: ClamAV could not be reached ({date}): {reason}. Files wait and are scanned once it answers; switching scanning off releases them.
antivirus.counts: Waiting: {pending} · clean: {clean} · virus found: {infected} · too large to scan: {unscanned}
antivirus.foundHint: They stay blocked until their owner deletes them.
push.event.infected: a virus is found in one of your files
antivirus.missing: ClamAV is not installed on this server, or it does not answer.
antivirus.installHint: Installs ClamAV from the system's packages and downloads its virus database. It takes a few minutes and uses about 1.5 GB of memory.
antivirus.lowMemory: This server has {memory} MB of memory. ClamAV needs about 1.5 GB on top of MagiSend, so give it at least 2.5 GB first (in Proxmox: the container's Resources) and come back.
antivirus.docker: With Docker, ClamAV runs as its own container: remove the # in front of the clamav lines and MAGISEND_CLAMAV in docker-compose.yml and start MagiSend again. The first start downloads the virus database and takes a few minutes.
antivirus.manual: Install the clamav-daemon package on this server and set StreamMaxLength 100M, MaxFileSize 100M, MaxScanSize 400M and AlertExceedsMax true in /etc/clamav/clamd.conf; the README explains it.
errors.antivirus_cannot_install: ClamAV can only be installed from here on a MagiSend installed with the installer; see the README for the other ways.
errors.antivirus_memory: ClamAV needs about 1.5 GB of memory; give this server at least 2.5 GB first.
errors.zip_too_many: This archive holds too many files, or names too long together: a folder holds at most 1,000 files, and a tar file is read up to 10,000 entries.
library.extractSkipped: {count} items were left out: system files, password-protected files or names that are not allowed.
library.extractSkippedOne: 1 item was left out: a system file, a password-protected file or a name that is not allowed.
errors.backup_invalid: Use an absolute folder MagiSend can write to, a daily or weekly schedule, and keep 1–100 backups.
missing.title: Files whose data is missing
missing.intro: {count} files have lost their stored data, for example after an older backup was restored. Downloading them fails.
missing.inLinks: {count} of them are in links rather than the library: edit or delete those links to remove them.
missing.removeConfirm: Remove the {count} library files whose data is gone?
missing.removed: {count} files were removed from the library.
missing.unreachable: These locations did not answer, so their files were not checked: {locations}
missing.wrong: These locations look like the wrong disk or share is mounted, so nothing can be removed: {locations}
unclaimed.title: Files MagiSend doesn't know
unclaimed.intro: {count} files ({size}) were found in the storage folders that the database does not know, for example after an older backup was restored. They are kept aside for {days} days and then deleted.
unclaimed.restoreHint: Putting them back adds each file to its owner's library, in its old folder and with its old name when MagiSend knows them; others go to Recovered files in your library.
unclaimed.deleteConfirm: Delete these {count} files for good? This cannot be undone.
unclaimed.restoredSome: {count} files were put back; {failed} could not be and are still listed.
backup.title: Backups
backup.intro: A backup is one .tar file with a copy of the database and, if you choose, the stored files. It is made while MagiSend keeps running, and has a RESTORE.txt that explains how to put it back.
backup.folderHint: An absolute folder, ideally on another disk or a network share. Empty means the backups folder inside the data folder.
backup.keepHint: Older ones are deleted when a new backup is made.
backup.filesHint: Without files a backup holds accounts, settings, links and folders, and is small. With files it is as large as everything stored.
backup.filesSized: The files in the data folder ({size}). Without files a backup holds accounts, settings, links, folders and file details, and is small.
backup.storageHint: Copies the files on {locations} into every backup as well. Leave this off for large storage and back it up with its own tools (for example rsync or snapshots on the NAS); RAID alone is not a backup.
backup.estimate: Each backup will be about {size}; keeping {keep} uses about {total}.
backup.incomplete: The last backup ({date}) is incomplete. It could not copy: {missing}. Its file MISSING.txt lists everything that is missing.
notes.title: Title
notes.titlePlaceholder: Title (optional — the first line is used)
notes.textPlaceholder: Write here. Markdown works: # heading, **bold**, - list, - [ ] checklist.
notes.conflict: Changed somewhere else — copy your text and reopen the note
notes.noneHint: Notes are Markdown files in your library: they can be shared, have a history and go to the trash like any file.

antivirus.needsSettings: ClamAV on this server is not set up the way MagiSend needs: files it cannot scan whole (larger than its limits, such as Debian's 25 MB) may be reported clean. Apply the recommended settings to scan files up to 100 MB whole and to mark the rest unscanned.
